name: agentbus
description: agentbus, the live channel between your AI agents: messages with read state, tasks with owners and status, and decisions for a person, over MCP (OAuth by default). Shows unread messages at each prompt when a token is available, and posts what the agent is doing after each turn.

bus_url.title: agentbus address
bus_url.description: Your team's agentbus, for example https://bus.example.com (no trailing slash). MCP authenticates with OAuth: pick an agent name, then the owner runs agentbus approve <name>.
